programme.title: Una Navidad Complicada
programme.desc: En medio de la temporada navideña, Leticia y Guillermo, divorciados desde hace años, enfrentan una situación inesperada cuando su hijo adolescente recurre a una trampa para reunirlos, falsificando un correo electrónico conde invita a Guillermo y su nueva novia a la casa familiar para Navidad. A medida que la forzada convivencia avanza, la relación entre Guillermo y su exesposa va cambiando. Guillermo descubre cuanto extraña su antigua vida, su vida familiar estable y hermosa. Y descubre que sigue amando a Leticia. Pero, para regresar definitivamente, necesita ganarse el perdón de Leticia y demostrarle que está dispuesto a cambiar. No es tan fácil, pero tal vez el espíritu navideño ayude a que suceda el milagro.

programme.title: Intercambio Navideno
programme.desc: MAYA y ANA MARÍA son gemelas. Pero fueron separadas al nacer y entregadas a diferentes familias. Fueron criadas de maneras opuestas. ANA MARÍA es ahora una exitosa empresaria divorciada, que solo piensa en su éxito y en el trabajo. MAYA una incansable filántropa, criada por una familia que se dedica a trabajar en pro de los más necesitados. Ya adultas se descubren una a la otra y deciden guardar el secreto, para no hacer daño a sus familias. Pero una navidad deciden hacer la travesura de intercambiar sus vidas por una noche. Sin sospechar que aquella decisión las cambiará para siempre.

programme.title: Tomame o Dejame
programme.desc: Los mafiosos ded Felipe secuestran a Lara. Jennifer se arrepienter de haberse casado con Cristobal, extranando su etapa de amante.

programme.title: Tomame o Dejame
programme.desc: Felipe, obsesionado con la venganza de Andres, coordina un ataque a la clinica para secuestra al asesino que ayudaron. Lara descubre que Adan sigue casado. Andres sale herido de este ataque.

programme.title: Escandalos - Hombre de Familia
programme.desc: Un veterano comediante ha sido por años estrella de televisión y símbolo de los más conservadores valores familiares, a través del programa que protagoniza. Cuando varias mujeres lo acusan de haberlas agredido sexualmente, su imagen se desmorona y la posibilidad de regresar al estrellato con un nuevo show se arruina.

programme.title: Escandalos - Sonata Nocturna
programme.desc: Una famosas concertista es acusada de abuso senil hacia su anciana madre. Entre las dos intentarán demostrar al mundo que la acusación es falsa. Pero iremos descubriendo que la enfermiza relación madre/hija es más complicada de lo que se sospecha.

programme.title: Una Navidad Para Recordar
programme.desc: Sebastián detesta la navidad. Y esta le será particularmente difícil, puesto que es la primera que pasa sin sus hijos, después de un duro divorcio. Decide alejarse de la ciudad y pasar la temporada en la casa en que nació, visitando a su madre Ángela, que padece alzheimer. programme.title: Escandalos - La Viuda Negra
programme.desc: La mujer de un importante empresario, al verse en la posibilidad de perder su seguridad económica a causa de un divorcio, planifica el asesinato de su esposo a través de un sicario. Parece el crimen perfecto y ella disfruta de las consecuencias de su acción, pero cinco años más tarde todo se vuelve en su contra.

programme.title: Escandalos - De Vuelta al Closet
programme.desc: Un canal de televisión pone su apuesta del rating en un nuevo reality show donde buscan esposo a una famosa vedette. Pero ella suspende el programa dos días antes de su inicio anunciando que va a casarse con “el verdadero amor de su vida”. Todo toma un giro inesperado cuando el canal rival descubre la “vida secreta” del futuro esposo.

programme.title: Escandalos - Nada es Para Siempre
programme.desc: Uno de los grupos juveniles más importantes de Latinoamérica, se vio envuelto en el escándalo, luego que dos de sus integrantes fueran capturados con drogas, en un aeropuerto, mientras se encontraban en plena su gira de promoción. Este hecho provocó la salida de los dos integrantes y aceleró la caída final del grupo.

programme.title: Escandalos - Doble Vida
programme.desc: Un famoso actor, ya cerca de los sesenta años, vive en permanente conflicto con su sexualidad. Casado y con varios hijos de un largo matrimonio, mantiene paralelamente relaciones homosexuales. Cuando una de estas relaciones se rompe, su ex pareja amenaza con revelar al mundo la doble vida del famoso actor.

programme.desc: Only Mother Isabel is convinced of the noble attitude of her girl who desisted from her intentions to collect the betrayal of the three women and even asked for their forgiveness. Ezequiel tells Camila about his son's engagement and she reproaches him for going so fast, forgetting the great love he said he had for her.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto with double intentions invites Camila to dinner at his house so that she can get to know her new family. Ezequiel insists on talking to her about romance and feelings and the young woman reminds him that this is not what they agreed upon. Marcelina visits Ezequiel in the hospital and he takes the opportunity to threaten her if she tries to hurt Camila again.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila is alert to the obvious hypocrisy of Fausto and Patricia, however, she manages to get out of the incessant questions by sticking to her strategy of bringing peace to the two families. Inconvenient, with Roger and Gregorio, she tells Ezequiel who promises her that he will be able to take revenge for everything they have done to her.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila and Max offend each other with irony and hurtful phrases. The four women involved in the betrayal meet again to ally themselves and annul Camila, but Mother Isabel prevails. Both Father Tiziano and Luciano warn about the danger of the marriage between Camila and Ezequiel.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel accepts that Camila will not marry him for love and they make a pact. In Masquerade, Ezequiel announces the engagement before his children and the entire staff; there are various reactions.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Family and friends present at the celebration. Camila, beautiful and dazzling, makes an impact and Ezequiel introduces her as the future Mrs. López Méndez, but she is unable to respond to the surprising shots that wound Ezequiel. Marcelina, guilty of the act, clarifies that the shots were not meant for Ezequiel, but to kill Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Detective Torrealba presses Marcelina; Max tries to convince him that his mother is sick and not responsible for her actions. Camila is detained for questioning and replies that she does not wish to press charges against Marcelina and her only desire is to live in peace and be happy.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max comes to get Camila from the police, she thanks him for the gesture but refuses to reveal her plans to him. programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila visits Marcelina. Before her and Max tells her that it was Rosa, her mother, who made her change her mind, and they will not press charges against her. programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: Insight with Haslinda Amin
programme.desc: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.

programme.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa
programme.desc: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa. Linking the market drivers from overnight in the US and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep dive analysis of the top business, energy and geopolitical stories shaping the decisions of traders across the Middle East, Africa and beyond.

programme.title: Bloomberg Daybreak Europe
programme.desc: Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. And we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins.

programme.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
programme.desc: The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game.

programme.title: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua
programme.desc: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

programme.title: Bloomberg Brief
programme.desc: Bloomberg Brief delivers the market news, data and analysis you need to set your agenda.

programme.title: Bloomberg Surveillance
programme.desc: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern have the economy and global markets "under surveillance". Their daily conversations with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond cover the latest in business, investment, and geopolitics. No other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day.

programme.title: Bloomberg Open Interest

The program brings the audience interviews from the biggest names in the business, offering in-depth analysis and critical insights.

programme.title: Meet China: From Little Toys to Global Factories, How Chinese Creativity Travels
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we explore how “Made in China” is taking on new forms. A monster toy becomes a global collectible, an ocean park in southern China turns wonder into repeat visits, and a smart EV factory in Zhejiang shows how cars are built for overseas markets. In central China’s Xuchang, a small city supplies much of the world’s hair products, while in Guangxi, an Italian chef blends pizza with traditional medicinal food. From blind boxes to electric vehicles, wigs and a yam-and-lamb pizza, this episode reveals how Chinese creativity, scale and culture are reaching the world in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Follow the Money: Where Climate Capital Is Going
programme.desc: Clean energy investment has surpassed fossil fuel supply investment, signaling a fundamental shift in how markets address climate risk. Capital is accelerating into renewables, electrification, and industrial decarbonization—but how do we ensure these funds drive climate action? CGTN's Guan Xin moderates a panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum, bringing together voices from government, business, and international institutions to explore the trends, challenges, and prospects of climate capital allocation. Tune in to find out where climate capital is flowing and explore the opportunities in the green transition.#SummerDavos2026

programme.title: BizTalk | Summer Davos special: New opportunities for growth in China
programme.desc:
The 17th Annual Meeting of the New Champions, also known as Summer Davos, is underway in Dalian. During the forum, China’s technological innovation, green development and business environment have once again become key topics of discussion.
In this special episode of BizTalk, CGTN speaks with Liu Zhenmin, China’s special envoy for climate change, Joe Ngai, chairman of McKinsey Greater China, and Leo Lee, president of Novartis China, to explore how China is cultivating new growth drivers amid a new wave of industrial transformation, and why “the next China is still China”.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.
We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.
One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.
We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.
One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc:
In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm?
In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Biztalk Special Coverage on AI EP3
programme.desc: The Token Economy Demand for AI tokens is surging, with trends like “tokenmaxxing” accelerating the race for computing power. As pressure mounts on computing and energy infrastructure, China is leveraging its clean energy strengths to support AI growth, while “token exports” emerge as a new way to deliver AI services to global users. What’s the future like for the “token economy”? Join us on BizTalk as we explore the economics behind the AI revolution.

programme.title: Andy Warhol Fluorescent
programme.desc: Warhol, evolutionary and controversial, was never afraid to break the mold and reshape the reals of art, advertising, & directing. But who was the real man being behind the colors in which he hid? Was it the art or the fame that controlled & spawned his unique creativity? Sabbatical Entertainment takes an in-depth look at the life and works of Andy Warhol.

programme.title: Crazy For Madonna
programme.desc: A biography of a universal icon of music and Hollywood, Madonna, better known as the Queen of Pop. Sabbatical Entertainment celebrates Madonna’s illustrious career spanning more than four decades, always pushing the boundaries of entertainment. Not afraid of controversy, the Material girl, through her talents, redefined pop culture history.

programme.title: Eastwood
programme.desc: Pay homage to Clint Eastwood, the oldest living cinematic icon. Success did not come easy for Eastwood, but throughout his career he has reaped numerous triumphs, directed more than 44 films, and acted in more than 72... Winner of over 150 awards including four Oscars, the iconic Eastwood has not only secured his place in the history of Hollywood, but in the history of world cinema. Bravo!!!

programme.title: For Our Eyes Only
programme.desc: In anticipation of the 25th chapter in the iconic James Bond Saga, Sabbatical Entertainment presents an enthralling documentary that recounts & relives all of 007’s menacing missions throughout this legendary cinematic franchise, from “Dr. No”, to the highly anticipated “No Time To Die.” Get to know the actors who have embodied the super spy: Connery, Lazenby, Moore, Dalton, Brosnan, and Craig, their similarities & the characteristics that differentiate each one when exhibiting 007’s well-known charm, class and elegance, combined with his physical and mental prowess, that make James Bond, a real life super hero.

programme.title: Oh Dior!

programme.title: Dances with the Wind
programme.desc: ‘Fury Dance’ is a story about a Korean protest dancer, Sam-hun Lee. He fought for the democratization of South Korea in the ‘80’s through dance, while giving up his own dream to become a ballerino. The film takes the viewer through prominent events in South Korean history, as Sam-hun dances to soothe the souls of victims who were killed by the Korean national violence during the past 30 years. During the 1980 Gwangju Massacre however, Sam-hun developed a panic disorder. So he crosses through the Eurasian rail with difficulty when invited to attend a festival to dance in France. Through his journey, he attempts to overcome his claustrophobic fears in France, revisits his lost dream of becoming a ballerino in Russia, and dances for the Holocaust victims in Poland. Documented for 15 years, this film is dedicated to those who lost their noble lives while fighting for freedom against the unjust political power.

programme.title: 1st Bite
programme.desc: Set on a tropical island in Thailand, the strange plight of a beleaguered chef who, while romancing a mysterious woman, discovers the diabolical Zen of cooking. Following a near death escape, he returns to Montreal and falls hard for the woman of his life who unfortunately craves only his cooking but not his loving. Worse still, strange things surfacing around him indicate that his journey to the Far East has deep, divine implications. The stage is set for him to take the 1st bite of true love and end the cycle of suffering for all involved.

programme.title: Úrsula Corberó y Chino Darin son puro fuego I Brujas de Zugarramurdi I Ministerio de brujas
programme.desc:
Bienvenidas al Ministerio de Brujas, donde cada martes a las 20h en Canal Barro, se enciende la hoguera y se queman verdades incómodas.
En este episodio, Carlos inauguró la nueva Subsecretaría de Misterios, trayendo algunas de las historias más oscuras y fascinantes de España: Las brujas de Zugarramurdi. La Inquisición y sus castigos. Y esos misterios que siguen latiendo entre cuevas, sombras y supersticiones.
Como siempre, en la hoguera ardieron muchas cosas: – Reglas imposibles. – Gente manipuladora que tensa la cuerda. – Vampiros energéticos y demás criaturas emocionales.
Pero el clímax llegó cuando las brujas leyeron las cartas astrales de Úrsula Corberó y Chino Darín en vivo. Él, con gen de líder pero alma aniñada y sexy. Ella, fuego puro, control y magnetismo. Juntos, una conexión casi kármica y familiar.
Además, se destacó en el Departamento de Archivos Clasificados a una nueva bruja ilustre: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, la voz que hechiza desde el feminismo y la palabra.
Y para cerrar con placer y picardía, en la Secretaría de Venus en Tanga, hubo tarot erótico: deseo, destino y mucha, mucha energía ardiente.
💜 Ministerio de Brujas: el único ministerio donde el fuego limpia, el deseo guía y la magia es ley. 📆 Todos los martes a las 20h (España) en @CanalBarro .

programme.title: Claudia Luchetti abre portales en vivo | La decodificadora más famosa en Ministerio de Brujas
programme.desc:
En este nuevo capítulo del Ministerio de Brujas, las ministras del zodiaco reciben a una invitada especial: Claudia Luchetti, la decodificadora más famosa de Argentina, una mujer que camina entre la neurociencia, la Kábbalah y la energía invisible. Coach, conferencista y bruja de luz, Claudia nos cuenta cómo llega a ser bruja, qué siente cuando baja información, y cuáles fueron los casos más paranormales que vivió acompañando a otros en su transformación.
Además, en esta edición: 🔥 El Protocolo de la Hoguera: lo que decidimos quemar —desde los machirulos hasta los taladros del vecino. 💋 Secretaría de Venus en Tanga: exploramos la energía erótica de Tauro, los placeres mundanos, los aromas, las texturas y los sentidos. 🎬 Cinematografía Zodiazal: nuevas películas bajo la lupa astrológica. 🌌 Boletín de Movimientos Planetarios: con ChongaZen desentrañando el clima cósmico. 📚 Archivos Clasificados de Brujas: hoy, la artista Tracey Emin, la mujer que transformó su cama en arte y su dolor en revolución.
Y como siempre, los Sindicatos Zodiacales elevan sus reclamos: ♒ Acuario: “Podridos de que nos digan fríos.” ♋ Cáncer: “¿Todo tenemos que sentir?” ♎ Libra: “¡Basta de falsedad!” ♑ Capricornio (sindicato de Claudia): “Queremos reconocimiento celestial por exceso de responsabilidad terrenal.”
El Ministerio de Brujas no explica. Encanta. Entre astros, carcajadas y conjuros, abrimos portales donde otros archivan silencios.
📅 Todos los martes 20:00 (España) / 15:00 (Argentina) 📺 En YouTube y Kick de @canalbarro

programme.title: Ministerio de Brujas: el primer gobierno astral de la historia #astrologia #esoterismo #tarot
programme.desc:
Bienvenidas, bienvenidos y bienvenides al Ministerio de Brujas, el nuevo programa del Canal Barro donde la intuición, el arte y la magia se sientan a la misma mesa. Este primer episodio es un aquelarre de verdad: fuego, deseo, política, feminismo y mucho humor.
Las ministras @chongazen, @marianaenvozalta y @zakurapill abren las puertas del ministerio con un comunicado oficial:
“El Ministerio de Brujas no es un edificio ni un expediente. Es un estado de ánimo. Es ese rincón donde las brujas nos reunimos para decir lo que nadie dice, para reírnos de lo serio y darle seriedad a lo que parece una pavada.”
En este primer encuentro: - Protocolo de la Hoguera: adiós a los políticos, los alquileres imposibles, los machirulos, los vampiros energéticos y los hombres de Cáncer. Todo lo que sobra… se quema y se transmuta. - Secretaría de Venus en Tanga: astrología y erotismo sin censura. ¿Qué energía nos mueve en esta luna llena de Aries? - Boletín Oficial de Movimientos Planetarios: ChongaZen trae el parte astrológico del cielo y sus efectos terrenales. - Departamento de Estrellas y Sábanas: compatibilidades cósmicas. Hoy: Penélope Cruz y Javier Bardem. - Dirección de Cinematografía Zodiazal: la Dra. Fernanda Garrido recomienda películas según los elementos zodiacales. - Archivos Clasificados de Brujas: homenaje a Violeta Parra, la artista chilena que convirtió su dolor en himno y su rebeldía en legado eterno.
Aquí no hay jerarquías ni jefes: mandan las palabras, la energía y la conexión. Si entraste, ya eres parte del aquelarre.
📅 En vivo todos los martes a las 20h :(hora España) en YouTube @CanalBarro

programme.title: Hablemos claro de la menopausia con Celia Sancho en Matronas al Rescate.
programme.desc:
Bienvenida a Matronas al Rescate, el programa donde se habla claro, se ríe fuerte y se normaliza lo que nadie quiere nombrar. En este episodio, las matronas se enfrentan a un tema que llega antes de lo que crees: la menopausia y la perimenopausia. Para ello, invitan a Celia Sancho, una experta que viene a explicar (sin drama ni eufemismos) qué pasa realmente cuando el cuerpo cambia de guion.
👩‍⚕️ Gema está enfadada porque no consigue hacer un trámite digital. 🏫 Leo y Martina se quedan a dormir en el cole. 😬 Un paciente chungo, una amiga que no levanta cabeza y un cumpleaños infantil con más puntos en la vagina de la madre que en la tarta. Y entre todo esto: el Día Mundial de la Salud Mental, el parto en casa de Verdeliss, el ADN de tus ex que sigue dentro de ti (microquimerismo) y las cesáreas privadas que duplican lo que recomienda la OMS.
Con Celia hablamos de síntomas, soluciones, sexualidad y autoconocimiento, porque no es el fin de nada: es una nueva versión de ti.
💬 Conclusión: no es “la edad”, es una nueva temporada hormonal. Y aquí están las matronas para acompañarte con humor, ciencia y cero filtros.
📅 Nuevo episodio cada Jueves a las 11h en el canal de YouTube de @CanalBarro Presentan: las Matronas al Rescate.

programme.title: ¿Las pantallas están criando a tus hijos? Sol Macaluso y Fátima de Francisco en Matronas al Rescate
programme.desc:
uevo programa de Matronas al Rescate en Canal Barro — y esta vez tocamos uno de los temas más urgentes: cómo las pantallas, las redes sociales y la inteligencia artificial están afectando a la infancia.
Las invitadas de lujo fueron: 💬 Sol Macaluso, periodista e influencer, que compartió su experiencia personal de crianza en tiempos digitales. 📚 Fátima de Francisco, especialista en educación y crianza, que nos habló de los riesgos y efectos reales del uso de pantallas y recomendó libros imprescindibles para madres y padres.
Además: 🍼 Desmontamos trucos virales para dormir bebés, 🧠 debatimos sobre educación sexual y responsabilidad digital, 😱 y Fátima nos dejó helados con un dato impactante: el vídeo pornográfico más descargado de 2017 fue el de “La Manada”, una muestra brutal de la falta de educación sexual y empatía social que seguimos arrastrando.
Un programa necesario, incómodo, pero urgente. 👉 Matronas al Rescate, todos los jueves a las 11:00 AM (España) en YouTube Canal Barro.

programme.title: Matronas: prematuros, alimentos y un 1,2,3 divertido para explicar los básicos de nutrición
programme.desc:
Nuevo jueves en Matronas al Rescate (todos los jueves a las 11:00h en @CanalBarro y venimos cargadas de temas que importan, que ayudan y que, sí, también hacen reír.
En este episodio hablamos de:
✨ Día Mundial del Prematuro — Atención especializada, UCIN, apoyo emocional y derechos que aún faltan. — La revolución del útero artificial. — Cómo afectan los disruptores endocrinos.
🍼 Alimentación Complementaria (AC) con Arantxa — Señales reales de que un bebé está listo. — BLW vs cuchara: corte seguro, práctica en directo y cero dramas. — Plato Harvard, cantidades reales y alimentos estrella. — Alimentos NO recomendados antes del año y por qué. — Juegos, fallos, explicaciones y risas.
🥄 Sueño, hierro, alergias y alimentos clave — Qué favorece el sueño. — Cómo sumar hierro de forma eficaz. — El mapa de alérgenos sin miedo. — Pescados con mercurio: los que sí, los que no. — Todos los nombres del azúcar (sí, TODOS).
🚨 Seguridad y primeros auxilios — Arcada vs atragantamiento: cómo diferenciarlo de verdad. — Técnica básica que toda madre debería saber.
😅 Destete Respetuoso — Qué es, cómo se hace y cómo evitar convertirlo en tragedia griega. — Destete nocturno, diario de tomas y herramientas prácticas.
💜 Además: Cumple de Alejandro, fin de semana de caca(s), cocido de mamá, citologías, sección joven con manualidades… y la liada de Ana Brito con la lactancia prolongada.
Si eres madre, padre, tía, tío, futura familia o simplemente te obsesiona entender cómo sobreviven los bebés… este episodio te va a salvar media vida.
En este episodio de Matronas nos pusimos en modo clásico total: jugamos al mítico “1,2,3… responda otra vez” para explicar los alimentos clave del embarazo sin que nadie cabecee del aburrimiento. Un repaso nutricional hecho juego, con ritmo de concurso vintage y momentos gloriosos que solo pueden ocurrir cuando mezclas conocimiento, velocidad mental y mucha chispa.
Además, las matronas bajaron a tierra mitos, explicaron qué comer, qué evitar y por qué, mientras el equipo competía como si hubiera bote final. Es divulgación, sí… pero disfrazada de tele de culto.
El próximo episodio promete más ciencia, más humor y alguna que otra sorpresa que hará que estudiar embarazo sea más adictivo que un viernes de gala.
#MatronasAlRescate #AlimentaciónComplementaria #BLW #Prematuros #DesteteRespetuoso #Bebés #MaternidadReal #CanalBarro #Emmatrona

programme.title: ¿Las pantallas están criando a tus hijos? Sol Macaluso y Fátima de Francisco en Matronas al Rescate
programme.desc:
uevo programa de Matronas al Rescate en Canal Barro — y esta vez tocamos uno de los temas más urgentes: cómo las pantallas, las redes sociales y la inteligencia artificial están afectando a la infancia.
Las invitadas de lujo fueron: 💬 Sol Macaluso, periodista e influencer, que compartió su experiencia personal de crianza en tiempos digitales. 📚 Fátima de Francisco, especialista en educación y crianza, que nos habló de los riesgos y efectos reales del uso de pantallas y recomendó libros imprescindibles para madres y padres.
Además: 🍼 Desmontamos trucos virales para dormir bebés, 🧠 debatimos sobre educación sexual y responsabilidad digital, 😱 y Fátima nos dejó helados con un dato impactante: el vídeo pornográfico más descargado de 2017 fue el de “La Manada”, una muestra brutal de la falta de educación sexual y empatía social que seguimos arrastrando.
Un programa necesario, incómodo, pero urgente. 👉 Matronas al Rescate, todos los jueves a las 11:00 AM (España) en YouTube Canal Barro.
#MatronasAlRescate #SolMacaluso #FatimaDeFrancisco #EducacionSexual #Pantallas #CrianzaDigital #CanalBarro #IA #InfanciaDigital

programme.title: La carta astral de Pedro Sanchez y Begoña Gómez I Begoña es la que manda I Ministerio de Brujas
programme.desc:
Este martes en Ministerio de Brujas (19:00h España, en Canal Barro), las ministras abrieron los portales del poder para leer las cartas astrales de Pedro Sánchez y Begoña Gómez 🔥. Lo que descubrieron dejó a todos con la boca abierta: ♑ Él, un hombre obsesionado con el poder, encantador pero peligroso en su ingenuidad. ♌ Ella, inteligente, estratega y con los pantalones del vínculo.
Además, en la Hoguera semanal ardieron los males cotidianos: 🚗 los Uber que nunca llegan, 😤 la gente que mastica con la boca abierta, ⚧ y un intenso debate sobre identidad y transparencia en las relaciones.
La bruja invitada de la semana fue Mercedes Jorqueira, voluntaria de la DANA, que contó en directo su experiencia ayudando en plena catástrofe. En el Departamento de Cinematografía Zodíacal, se recomendaron películas y series de desastres como Chernóbil y Lo imposible. Y en el Archivo de Brujas Quemadas, se honró la figura inmortal de Mercedes Sosa 🎶, voz y fuego eterno de América Latina.
✨ Ministerio de Brujas — el programa donde el poder se lee en las estrellas, se quema en la hoguera y se transforma en conciencia. Todos los martes a las 19:00h (España) en YouTube @arroba.barro.
#MinisterioDeBrujas #PedroSanchez #BegoñaGomez #Astrología #Brujas #CanalBarro #CartaAstral #MercedesSosa

programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Chantel Leavitt Bella Dama
programme.desc: Join host Sean Mobley as he sits down with the esteemed cigar maker, Chantel Leavitt, offering unique insights into the meticulous art of blending and the dedication required to craft exceptional cigars. Discover the inspiration behind Bella Dama's signature creations and gain a deeper appreciation for the nuances that define a truly remarkable smoke.

programme.title: Unrolled

programme.title: Cigar Essentials
programme.desc: In this episode of Cigar Essentials, Howard and Rachel G. showcase various cigar humidification and travel accessories, including a high-capacity cigar cabinet with internal lighting and a miniature "golf bag" travel humidor. They also demonstrate practical maintenance tools such as cigar scissors for controlled cutting and a waterproof, drop-resistant single-flame torch lighter designed for outdoor use.

programme.title: Cigar Essentials
programme.desc: In this episode of Cigar Essentials, hosts Howard G. and Rachel G. unbox and review five cigar accessories. They demonstrate a variety of tools, including a cedar-lined travel case kit , a digital humidometer , a rose-gold torch with an integrated cutter , and a set of protective mouthpieces. The show concludes with a heavy cast-iron monkey ashtray that vents smoke through its nostrils, with the hosts highlighting the unexpected affordability of all the products.

programme.title: Unrolled
programme.desc: Sean visits Captain's Cigar Lounge in downtown Clearwater, Florida, and speaks with General Manager Glenn. programme.title: Cigar Essentials
programme.desc: In this episode of Cigar Essentials, hosts Howard and Rachel G. showcase a variety of cigar accessories, including a high-quality acrylic humidor, a cedar-lined leather travel case, and lead-free crystal pairing glasses.

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Law Ream Zino Cigars
programme.desc: Sean lights up a conversation with Law Ream of Zino Cigars. Beyond his celebrated reviews, Law shares his journey into the world of cigar criticism, his unique methodology for dissecting a blend, and what he believes truly makes a cigar worthy of his praise.

programme.sub-title: Cigar City Unrolled - Grand Cathedral Cigars

programme.title: Unrolled

programme.title: Burn Rate
programme.sub-title: Burn Rate - Drew Estate Undercrown 10 Toro
programme.desc: On this episode of Burn Rate, hosts Bryan Baiss and Chris Kelly review the Undercrown 10 by Drew Estate Toro, evaluating its craftsmanship and flavor profile which featured dry cherry and black pepper, noting a consistently burning cigar despite its initial dryness.

programme.title: Cigar City Unrolled
programme.desc: On this episode of Unrolled, we take a look at The Cigar Castle! General Manager Rick is here to show us this unique lounge with a wide variety of selection and an impressive humidor!

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Lynn Hawkins Plasencia Cigars
programme.desc: Sean sits down with Lynn Hawkins of Placencia Cigars, one of the most respected names in the industry. Lynn pulls back the curtain on Placencia's extensive history as a leading grower and producer, sharing insights into their meticulous tobacco cultivation, the intricate art of their cigar manufacturing process, and what makes their family's legacy truly stand out in the world of premium cigars.

programme.title: Unrolled
programme.desc: In this episode of Unrolled, Sean Mobley visits Stogie Pairing Cigar Lounge in Fort Myers, Florida, where owners Joey and Jessica showcase their establishment, boasting 28 beer taps, 75 types of bottled and canned beers, and a full wine selection, emphasizing their commitment to diverse pairings for cigars.

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Rick Rodriguez West Tampa Tobacco Co
programme.desc: In this episode of "Behind the Blend," Sean Mobley interviews Rick Rodriguez, also known as "Chef Rick," from West Tampa Tobacco, who explains his nickname comes from blending tobacco like a chef uses food to create a desired flavor profile. Rick introduces new cigars like the "Circle of Life," a tribute to his mentors, and the "Double Crab," part of a Tampa-inspired trilogy, shaped like a "flying pig". He shares his personal journey into the cigar industry at age 40 and emphasizes that for him, cigars represent "connection" and a "gateway for a new friendship".

programme.title: Unrolled
programme.desc: In this episode of Unrolled, Sean Mobley visits Stogie Pairing Cigar Lounge in Fort Myers, Florida, where owners Joey and Jessica showcase their establishment, boasting 28 beer taps, 75 types of bottled and canned beers, and a full wine selection, emphasizing their commitment to diverse pairings for cigars.

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Steven Bartell Molon Labe
programme.desc: Join host Sean Mobley as he sits down with Steven Bartell, the visionary owner and founder of Molon Labe. Discover the story behind the only company in the world that combines rare reserve cigars, whiskey, and coffee all under one roof.

programme.title: Burn Rate
programme.sub-title: Burn Rate - Southern Draw Rose Of Sharon Dozen Roses Solomon
programme.desc: In this episode of "Burn Rate," hosts Bryan and Chris Kelly review the Southern Draw Rose of Sharon, Dozen Roses, a Casa de Montecristo exclusive in a Salomon vitola. They praise its craftsmanship, noting the oily, thin-veined Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper and consistent burn.

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Brian Motola And George Hadweh Cavalier
programme.desc: In this episode of "Behind the Blend," Sean Mobley interviews Brian and George from Cavalier Cigars, who discuss their roles within the company, with Brian as a partner in the Honduran factory (FBT) and George as the sales representative for Florida and Puerto Rico. Brian shares his recent full-time move to Honduras, highlighting the country's beauty and the factory's unique practice of hand-applying gold leaf to cigars, a process where empowered employees can reject imperfect products.

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Desiree Sylver Drunk Chicken
programme.desc: Established in 2019, Drunk Chicken Cigars (DC Cigars) are handmade in the U.S.A. to create premium flavor profiles. Every combination of tobacco leaf, including the filler, binder, and wrapper, was chosen to produce an assortment of smooth, rich, and savory cigars with a variety of customers in mind. Join Sean has he dicusses the mission of the DC Cigars family is to produce premium cigars that can be smoked anytime of the day.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Jingmai Wanderings: A Symphony of Humans and Tea
programme.desc: As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Mount Jingmai embodies the ecological wisdom of forest–tea symbiosis and the rich cultural diversity of its ethnic communities. It plays a vital role in biodiversity conservation and the preservation of traditional tea culture. This episode follows the stories of representative individuals to explore three key themes — heritage preservation, ecological sustainability, and youth empowerment — revealing the unique charm and sustainable development model of Mount Jingmai.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.1
programme.desc: Join Tianran He in Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. Fed by the Yarlung Zangbo River and abundant rainfall, this lush subtropical region is home to some of Xizan’g most unique scenery. From sacred mountains and ancient monasteries, to cruising along Nyingchi’s mother river, wandering alpine meadows and savoring stone pot chicken – a beloved local delicacy, Tianran uncovers the beauty of Nyingchi.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Kung fu journey up Wudang Mountains
programme.desc: Located in central China's Hubei Province, Wudang Mountains is a UNESCO World Natural and Cultural Heritage site recognized as the cradle of Wudang kung fu and as a renowned Taoist sanctuary. Every year, young students from different parts of China flock to these well-established kung fu academies to experience a childhood like no other. Li Weimu and Li Muzi study at two separate kung fu academies, and are following their own paths at Wudang Mountains.

programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programme.title: Foodwise: How to Order Chinese Food
programme.desc: How do you order Chinese food? What's the best way to pair dishes? And what's up with the naming system? In this episode, hosts Tianran and Eva will give you a crash course on everything from deciphering the menu and choosing the right restaurant, to pairing dishes according to color, aroma, taste, and form, so that by the end of the show, you too can feast your friends like a pro.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: In this episode, Host Tianran He is on a mission: To reach the summit of Mount Siguniang, a towering snowcapped mountain in southwestern China. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China’s most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang’s First Peak – this time, he’s all in.

programme.title: Pingyao Hand-Polished Lacquer Art
programme.desc: Pingyao is an old town with a history of over 2,700 years in the north of China, in Shanxi Province. The rich cultural heritage it built up over the centuries eventually gave rise to a very special art—Tuiguang lacquerware. This hand-polished lacquerware, unique to Pingyao, is recognized as one of the four representative lacquerwares of China.

programme.title: ALL THE LIVES WE LIVE: A man behind the scenes, in every season
programme.desc:
Today we continue with our new series “All the Lives We Live”—spotlighting five young Chinese people who are breaking the mold. They’ve chosen unconventional paths, excel at what they do, and bring passion and personality to every step. In their own way, they’re redefining what it means to be young—and promising—in today’s China.
In this episode, we meet Lao Feng—a man living two distinct lives. In winter, he tunes snowboards. In spring, he runs a coffee festival. From waxing boards to curating brews, his story is a seamless blend of passion, precision, and seasonal rhythm.

programme.title: Kung fu journey up Wudang Mountains

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals. The episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

They’ve chosen unconventional paths, excel at what they do, and bring passion and personality to every step. In their own way, they’re redefining what it means to be young—and promising—in today’s China.
In this episode, we meet Lao Feng—a man living two distinct lives. In winter, he tunes snowboards. In spring, he runs a coffee festival. From waxing boards to curating brews, his story is a seamless blend of passion, precision, and seasonal rhythm.

programme.title: Kung fu journey up Wudang Mountains
programme.desc: Located in central China's Hubei Province, Wudang Mountains is a UNESCO World Natural and Cultural Heritage site recognized as the cradle of Wudang kung fu and as a renowned Taoist sanctuary. Every year, young students from different parts of China flock to these well-established kung fu academies to experience a childhood like no other. Li Weimu and Li Muzi study at two separate kung fu academies, and are following their own paths at Wudang Mountains.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals. The episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He meets the Lhoba people, China’s smallest ethnic group, who show him their traditional hunting attire. At a sacred lake, Tianran visits an ancient monastery and witnesses the 3000-year-old dance of the Gongbo Tibetans, before venturing to a remote village to experience their their way of life.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: Breathing new life into century-old Yueju Opera
programme.desc: Yueju Opera is one of the five major Chinese operas. It is skillful in narration and sentiment and is popular across China. This timeless form of intangible cultural heritage now has new apprentices. We followed a young duo of Yueju Opera performers: eleven-year-old Wang Yuhan and her stage partner, nine-year-old Huang Xinru in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, as they shared kindred spirits in inheriting the performing art of Yueju Opera.

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: "Foodwise" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. From the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods!

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Changbai Mountain
programme.desc: An unforgettable adventure awaits amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Changbai Mountain! Embark on a trek through pristine birch forests, marvel at the majestic power of the world's deepest volcanic waterfall, and uncover hidden gems along the way. Indulge in soaking in natural hot springs and experience exhilarating rafting down mountain streams, all leading to the final destination: Tianchi Lake, a heavenly oasis nestled in the clouds. Join the Travelogue team as we delve into the beauty of Changbai Mountain.

programme.title: A Journey on Water from Wuxi to Yixing
programme.desc: Water has always been the heartbeat of human civilization, nurturing the cities it weaves through. In eastern China, the Grand Canal flows across Wuxi, etching its path through history. From the first drops that carved out its waterways to the thriving metropolis we see today, Wuxi’s story is inseparable from the canal that gave it life. In this episode, we uncover how the waters have shaped Wuxi’s identity. This is the story of a city born of water, where the past and present flow together, crafting the future.

programme.title: From office hours to beats, living life in different rhythms
programme.desc:

In this episode, we take you into the vibrant world of Funkie. From spinning records to sharing cultural stories, he’s all about connecting through music. Let’s dive into his unique journey.

programme.title: Breathing new life into century-old Yueju Opera

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history. Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode shows how true inner strength is like traditional timber architecture: stable, balanced, and built from within.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programme.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou’s traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: Echoes of Green
programme.desc: Echoes of Green takes viewers deep into Anji’s bamboo forests and mountain villages, where a new generation of Chinese youth is redefining how to live with nature. Through stories of outdoor sports, forest cafés, tea rituals, and family farms, the series shows how ecological ideals have become everyday choices and creative lifestyles. It is not just about landscapes, but about people — young dreamers proving that prosperity and nature can grow side by side, and that culture gives life to sustainability.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious?figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Inner Mongolia’s Frozen Wonderland
programme.desc: In this episode, we feature the Winter Nadam Fair and winter sports in Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia. By late December, the Hulunbuir Grassland is blanketed in ice and snow. Even in the bitter cold of around 30 degrees below zero, the grassland is alive with a festive bustle.

programme.title: China-Africa voices:Travel, writing and mutual understanding
programme.desc: A camel, a Samburu guide, and a Chinese traveler walking across Kenya's Rift Valley toward Lake Turkana. It sounds like the beginning of an adventure story. But behind the deserts and survival challenges lies a deeper story about friendship, cultural understanding and China-Africa exchanges.We speak with Chinese photographer Qi Lin, author of the Camel Diaries. Monica Cheru, Chairperson of the Zimbabwe Writers Association, also joins the conversation as we explore how ordinary people are shaping the relationship between China and Africa.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoxing
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing, before enjoying the freshest catch of the day. But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable!

programme.title: Outkirts of Wenzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He explores Wenzhou’s counties. From geological wonders and daring cliffside stunts at the Yandang Mountains, to rafting along the scenic Nanxi River, to harvesting seaweed and shellfish on the mud flats of the Dongtou Islands, Tianran discovers the ingenious ways the people of Wenzhou have transformed the challenges of living between mountains and seas into their greatest strengths.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc:
In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.
A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever.
And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Navigating the intersection of logic and art
programme.desc:
Today, we continue with our new series “All the Lives We Live,” spotlighting five young Chinese people who are breaking the mold. They’ve taken unconventional paths, excel at what they do, and infuse passion and personality into every step. In their own way, they’re redefining what it means to be young—and promising—in today’s China.
In this episode, we meet Xu Mengran. Xu leads a double life as both a textbook editor and a Peking Opera enthusiast. Let’s see how this unique balance of logic and art fuels her creativity and pushes the boundaries of what it means to be successful.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

Camel is the meritorious?figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Inner Mongolia’s Frozen Wonderland
programme.desc: In this episode, we feature the Winter Nadam Fair and winter sports in Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia. By late December, the Hulunbuir Grassland is blanketed in ice and snow. Even in the bitter cold of around 30 degrees below zero, the grassland is alive with a festive bustle.

programme.title: China-Africa voices:Travel, writing and mutual understanding
programme.desc: A camel, a Samburu guide, and a Chinese traveler walking across Kenya's Rift Valley toward Lake Turkana. It sounds like the beginning of an adventure story. But behind the deserts and survival challenges lies a deeper story about friendship, cultural understanding and China-Africa exchanges.We speak with Chinese photographer Qi Lin, author of the Camel Diaries. Monica Cheru, Chairperson of the Zimbabwe Writers Association, also joins the conversation as we explore how ordinary people are shaping the relationship between China and Africa.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoxing
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing, before enjoying the freshest catch of the day. But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable!

programme.title: Outkirts of Wenzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He explores Wenzhou’s counties. From geological wonders and daring cliffside stunts at the Yandang Mountains, to rafting along the scenic Nanxi River, to harvesting seaweed and shellfish on the mud flats of the Dongtou Islands, Tianran discovers the ingenious ways the people of Wenzhou have transformed the challenges of living between mountains and seas into their greatest strengths.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc:
In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.
A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever.
And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Navigating the intersection of logic and art
programme.desc:
Today, we continue with our new series “All the Lives We Live,” spotlighting five young Chinese people who are breaking the mold. They’ve taken unconventional paths, excel at what they do, and infuse passion and personality into every step. In their own way, they’re redefining what it means to be young—and promising—in today’s China.
In this episode, we meet Xu Mengran. Xu leads a double life as both a textbook editor and a Peking Opera enthusiast. Let’s see how this unique balance of logic and art fuels her creativity and pushes the boundaries of what it means to be successful.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Indigo Dreams: A Hue of Dali Tie-dye
programme.desc: Dali Tie-dye is the unique textile art of the Bai people, renowned for its exquisite hand-tying and traditional indigo dyeing techniques that create brilliant, one-of-a-kind patterns. Explore the cultural heritage and enduring beauty of this ancient craft from Yunnan.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation
programme.desc: Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. It is a site of an ancient city, ancient kingdom and ancient Shu culture in southwest of China, which is the largest in area, longest in time span and richest in cultural connotation. The total area covers 12 square kilometers, which was built over 3000 years ago. The cultural relics at Sanxingdui are precious cultural heritage of mankind, which contain rich historical, cultural and scientific value, and bespeak themselves as the most attractive ones amongst the multitude of the spectacular relics in China. In this episode, under the guide of the presenter, we visit the Sanxingdui Site Garden, archaeological Site and Sanxingdui Museum, show the amazing giant bronze mask, exquisite gold stuff, marvelous bronze divine tree etc., re-explore this mysterious and great civilization 3000 years ago.

programme.title: Time travel in Shunde: From ancient ancestral halls to dim sum
programme.desc: Two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia embarked on a journey to the historic Yang'e Village in Shunde, Guangdong Province. There, they savored authentic morning tea, visited ancient ancestral halls to appreciate the architectural grace and clan heritage of Lingnan, and experienced intangible cultural heritage to the rhythm of lion dance drums.

programme.title: Foodwise: Haikou
programme.desc: Welcome to Haikou, also known as the Coconut City! Join Tianran He in experiencing the unique culinary culture and urban character of this tropical paradise. From light and sweet coconut chicken hotpot to refreshing herbal desserts and spicy rice soup - a local favourite, every bite tells the story of the city's laid-back charm and beauty. We'll explore everything from Haikou's winding alleys and mangrove forests, to the culture of its southeast Asian diaspora, so come and discover this magical destination with us.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Bird-eye China Ep.1
programme.desc: Unfolding between the Kunlun, Altai and Tianshan ranges, cradling two vast basins, lies a beautiful land: Xinjiang. Join us on an aerial journey as we ascend the Tianshan to reveal the life-giving secrets of its crystal clear waters, before touching the summit of Bogda Peak, towering 5 km above sea-level, and gliding over the glittering, gem-like Tianchi Lake and the boundless grasslands that extend far beyond what even a bird’s eye can see into the west….

programme.title: Shenzhen：Before and Beneath the Skyscrapers
programme.desc: Episode 1 of Shenzhen: Past and Present of Shenzhen When it comes to Shenzhen, a pioneering city of China's reform and opening-up, people generally picture it as open, fashionable and bustling. Yet its history and culture are often dismissed as a "cultural desert" or merely a small fishing village. In this episode, we will take you on a journey to gain an in-depth insight into Shenzhen's history and culture.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game "Sifu" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to "eat porridge at night"
