programme.title: The Trail - S01:E04 - White Death
programme.desc: Snow, what the mountain men called white death, stops Laramy in his tracks. In addition, his trusty horse 7 has suffered a leg injury. Laramy must take care of Seven, battle through hunger, and survive the snowfall.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E04 - Pitch Black
programme.desc: Manny explores a primitive river in pitch black darkness & encounters a monster.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E05 - River of Drought
programme.desc: We explore a river during a terrible drought in Florida, to see what predators have migrated into it.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E06 - Adventure on the Aucilla River
programme.desc: Manny searches for predators and prey on the Aucilla River, a river that starts in Georgia's black water swamps and flows through Florida into the Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E03 - One Rhino at a Time
programme.desc: While visiting a secret orphanage that cares for rescued baby rhinos, Ivan discovers the blood, sweat, tears that goes into saving this endangered species. An emergency phone call sends him on an adventure with a group of local heroes to save the next newly orphaned rhino.

programme.title: Around China by Train Ep.2
programme.desc: This documentary follows Chinese and French hosts as they take six train routes across China, showcasing China’s urban culture and remarkable achievements along the way.

programme.title: Cities of the Future Ep.2
programme.desc: This documentary turns its lens to the essential infrastructure of China’s cities, filming 35 hidden projects—including flood control and drainage, emergency response, and water, electricity, and gas supply. From the perspectives of urban renewal, industrial innovation, and dynamic development, it offers a true record of China's urban growth that values what lies both above and below ground.

programme.title: Yangtze: The River of Life Ep.4
programme.desc: This documentary reveals the current ecological state of the Yangtze River basin—including its fish, wildlife, and plant life—while documenting the efforts behind the Yangtze River protection initiative.

programme.title: Yangtze: The River of Life Ep.5
programme.desc: This documentary reveals the current ecological state of the Yangtze River basin—including its fish, wildlife, and plant life—while documenting the efforts behind the Yangtze River protection initiative.

programme.title: General Guan Yu Ep.5
programme.desc: This documentary is a unique exploration of the late Eastern Han dynasty general Guan Yu. Through a gaming team's recreation of the Battle of Xiangfan, overseas collections of his porcelain sculptures, and a coming-of-age ceremony at Guandi temple, this episode recounts his military achievements, while describing a man of loyalty, righteousness, courage, and honor—and an enduring spiritual symbol for the Chinese people.

programme.title: Encounters Along the Silk Road Ep.1
programme.desc: This documentary selects three locations along the Belt and Road with deep historical and cultural roots: Luoyang in Henan, Weinan in Shaanxi, and Dunhuang in Gansu. Through the eyes of Chinese and international youth, it explores past and present Silk Road culture through stories of cultural exchange and mutual learning between China and the world.

programme.title: Timeless Ancient Structures The Temple of Heaven
programme.desc: Built on the southern end of Beijing's Central Axis, the Temple of Heaven has endured over the course of the last 600 years. Also a UNESCO World Heritage Site, it is described as a masterpiece of architecture and landscape design, and is a must-see attraction for domestic and foreign tourists alike. Join us as we explore its fascinating history and the significance of all the wonders it beholds.

programme.title: Encounters Along the Silk Road Ep.1
programme.desc: This documentary selects three locations along the Belt and Road with deep historical and cultural roots: Luoyang in Henan, Weinan in Shaanxi, and Dunhuang in Gansu. Through the eyes of Chinese and international youth, it explores past and present Silk Road culture through stories of cultural exchange and mutual learning between China and the world.

programme.title: Encounters Along the Silk Road Ep.2
programme.desc: This documentary selects three locations along the Belt and Road with deep historical and cultural roots: Luoyang in Henan, Weinan in Shaanxi, and Dunhuang in Gansu. programme.title: Encounters Along the Silk Road Ep.3

Through the eyes of Chinese and international youth, it explores past and present Silk Road culture through stories of cultural exchange and mutual learning between China and the world.

programme.title: Timeless Ancient Structures The Temple of Heaven
programme.desc: Built on the southern end of Beijing's Central Axis, the Temple of Heaven has endured over the course of the last 600 years. Also a UNESCO World Heritage Site, it is described as a masterpiece of architecture and landscape design, and is a must-see attraction for domestic and foreign tourists alike. Join us as we explore its fascinating history and the significance of all the wonders it beholds.

programme.title: Around China by Train Ep.5
programme.desc: This documentary follows Chinese and French hosts as they take six train routes across China, showcasing China’s urban culture and remarkable achievements along the way.

programme.title: Razor in China·Walk Again
programme.desc: This episode documents a groundbreaking surgery that uses technology to help those with spinal cord issues walk again. Hear from patients and doctors as they navigate the long road ahead, and the courage it takes to get there.

programme.title: Back to the Far Side
programme.desc: Hear the stories of the Chang'e-6 engineers and four international payload teams and how they achieved their key mission milestones. Spanning China, France, the Netherlands, Sweden, Italy, and Pakistan, it offers a global perspective on humanity's first-ever mission to bring back samples from the far side of the moon.

programme.title: The Call of Glaciers
programme.desc: The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau is one of the world's most climate-sensitive regions. As its indigenous peoples, animals, and plants face the impacts of climate change, a Gen Z environmentalist rediscovers her homeland, with plenty of new insight along the way.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker's Guide to China – Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: Documents the journey of host He Tianran and National Geographic photographer Ma Chunlin through the Changping and Haizi valleys, culminating in their crowning achievement: the summit of Mount Siguniang in Sichuan Province.

programme.title: To the Summit of the Earth Again Ep.1
programme.desc: Frontline Chinese scientists on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau enter the spotlight, showcasing a spirit of exploration and dedication alongside the vital contributions their expeditions make to China's ecological progress and global conservation.

programme.title: History Speaks 1
programme.desc: This documentary exposes the heinous crimes of the Japanese Imperial Army's germ warfare in China, restoring historical truth while sending China’s message of "learning from history and cherishing peace."

programme.title: History Speaks 2
programme.desc: During World War II, Japanese militarism continued to expand outward, bringing deep suffering to the nations of East Asia. As time passes, more and more witnesses to history are passing away. Meanwhile, right-wing forces within the Japanese government have attempted to downplay or even cover up this history of aggression, making the tough but necessary task of preserving the memory of the past more urgent than ever.

programme.title: Zero Hour 5
programme.desc: This documentary highlights the efforts of top students from leading universities in Latin America and Africa as they tackle one of the most important issues of our time: climate change. Their optimism, ingenuity, and talent stand in stark contrast to the realities of the communities around them— some of which are among the hardest hit by the extreme weather conditions that have come to define the current climate crisis.

programme.title: Foodwise: Veggie Beijing
programme.desc: Beijing's vegetarian cuisine may not always stand out, but it's always present—quietly thriving beneath the city's bustling food scene. These days, creative plant-based dishes, blending East and West, are capturing the tastes of young Beijingers. Join us as we explore the city's hidden veggie treasures, from historic hutongs to modern, bustling streets.

programme.title: Foodwise: How to Order Chinese Food
programme.desc: How do you order a meal at a Chinese restaurant? It's a question every first-time visitor to China struggles with. With so many dishes and names, picking the right one can be a real challenge. In this episode of Foodwise, hosts Tianran and Eva reveal the art of ordering, from deciphering the menu to find the right number of dishes for the right number of people.

programme.title: Zero Hour 4
programme.desc: Asian cities are among the most climate-vulnerable in the world. Yet some are still confident green solutions will help reduce the impact of climate change across the region. Today, young scientists in India are developing solutions to reduce greenhouse gases in the atmosphere, from renewable wind energy to replacing chemical fertilizers with organic alternatives.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chongqing
programme.desc: It is said that Chongqing offers flavors as bold as its skyline. In this episode, Foodwise hosts Tianran and Fu Anqi explore the city's winding stairs and steep lanes in search of authentic Chongqing cuisine—from spicy noodles and hotpot to the bold flavors of Jianghu dishes.

programme.title: Foodwise: Kunming
programme.desc: Kunming, Yunnan's culinary capital, gathers flavors from all across the province. In this episode, Foodwise host Tianran teams up with Ksyusha, a Ukrainian who has called Kunming home for the last ten years. Together, they’ll hunt for snacks in the local markets, eat rice noodles in the old city, forage for mushrooms, and explore Yunnan's lesser-known cuisines. By the end, you’ll understand why people say there are two kinds of people in the world—those who live in Kunming, and those who wish they did.

programme.title: Zero Hour 1
programme.desc: As China sets its sights on achieving carbon neutrality by 2060, young people across the country are looking for creative solutions to help reach that goal. At Tsinghua University, students are learning to become stewards of the planet through research, policymaking, and storytelling. Meanwhile, students in Shenzhen have developed new methods for collecting and using rainwater, innovative grass-planting methods in Inner Mongolia are making China's deserts more habitable, and renewable energy is gradually replacing traditional energy sources. Perhaps the dream of carbon neutrality is closer than we thought.

programme.title: PINKS 2.0 - S1E1
programme.desc: It’s been 20 years in the making — the return of the drag racing reality TV show that started it all. New host Bruno Massel. New network. Built by automotive enthusiasts, for automotive enthusiasts. In Episode 1, we take you along for the full journey — from the origins of PINKS racing to today’s PINKS 2.0 competition at Rockingham Dragway. You’ll meet the racers who put it all on the line and step into the legendary PINKS Circle. The road wasn’t easy. Breakdowns, setbacks, and hurdles stood in the way, and every racer had to fight just to make it to the track and earn their shot to compete. Sit back and enjoy the ride as we bring you PINKS 2.0.
